name: The Benevolent Hand: How HelixCorp Saved Meridian 88
description: A lavishly produced HelixCorp-commissioned retrospective crediting the corponation with stabilizing the Great Lakes corridor after nation-state collapse, featuring curated testimony from Tier 3-4 residents and carefully omitted casualty data from the Shelf Resettlement campaigns of 2181-2189. Every frame is licensed, optimized, and legally required viewing for new HelixCorp employees during onboarding. The neural-feed version includes emotional calibration layers that generate feelings of gratitude during key segments.
cultural_impact: Became the template for the entire 'Benevolent Hand' documentary genre, spawning imitators across every major corponation and entrenching revisionist history as a legitimate entertainment format.
story_hooks: A new HelixCorp employee notices a face in the documentary that matches a name on a sealed Shelf mortality list — someone officially listed as alive and grateful.
An archivist discovers the raw, unedited interview footage was never fully destroyed and has been circulating on physical media for years.
A filmmaker is hired to produce the sequel and slowly realizes the scale of what they're being asked to launder.
